item.title: The Philippines: Digital Bar Exams Transforming Legal Education
item.description: Regionalised and fully digital bar examinations are transforming legal education in the Philippines, significantly improving access, fairness and overall outcomes for law students across the country.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Pioneers Microbiology and Flexible Electronics
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University is advancing interdisciplinary research in microbiology and flexible electronics, driving innovation in healthcare, wearable technology and solutions to complex global challenges.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Transformation for a Future-Ready Economy
item.description: Vietnam is rapidly accelerating its digital transformation and data-driven growth, with the National Assembly, AI and strategic reforms at the core of building a high-tech, innovative and future-ready economy.

item.title: Singapore Welcomes Peru’s Milestone Accession to DEPA
item.description: Peru has concluded substantive discussions to join the Digital Economy Partnership Agreement, while Singapore continues to strengthen global digital trade through DEPA and ESDEA partnerships.

item.title: Malaysia: Johor Bahru Advances AI-Driven Smart City Systems
item.description: Johor Bahru is deploying autonomous buses AI-powered surveillance drones and real-time analytics to strengthen transport management public safety and smart city operations.

item.title: Australia: NSW Drives Smart, Digital Livestock Management
item.description: The New South Wales Government is investing AU$2 million in electronic identification readers to enhance more data-driven livestock management, traceability and biosecurity across sheep and goat farms.

item.title: Indonesia: Parents, Platforms Safeguard Children in Digital Era
item.description: Indonesia urges parents to actively supervise children online, highlighting the vital combined role of families, regulations and coordinated multi-agency efforts in safeguarding young users effectively.

item.title: HKU Projects Span AI, Quantum Science and Sustainability
item.description: HKU has secured over HK$72 million in 2025/26 Research Grants Council funding to advance cutting-edge technology-driven research across AI, biomedicine, quantum science, and environmental sustainability.

item.title: The Philippines: Blockchain Portal Boosts Budget Transparency
item.description: The Philippines is leveraging blockchain to secure the national budget, enhance transparency, prevent corruption and provide citizens with verifiable, tamper-proof access to government spending.

item.title: Singapore: Championing Responsible, Human-Centred AI
item.description: Minister of State Jasmin Lau highlighted the urgent need for ethical, people-centred, responsible and visionary leadership, continuous learning and sound judgment in driving AI and digital transformation across organisations.
